# catppuccin theme inputs

Source: https://github.com/catppuccin/jetbrains

Commit: `71b78a50557d87af64ec75bb1b1bdfa17f416ed8`

License: MIT (`LICENSE`). Exact upstream bytes and hashes are recorded in assets.tsv.

Original author fields are preserved. If absent, use upstream vendor credit: Catppuccin.

Release: v3.6.1; https://github.com/catppuccin/jetbrains/releases/download/v3.6.1/Catppuccin.Theme-3.6.1.jar; SHA-256 3a1104e0db53ff5ba216c94c9e730a85c7ac2847f4e5fe82d91b99dc91045fff. Source pin is the resolved release tag commit.

- `themes/latte.theme.json`: Catppuccin Latte (`catppuccin-latte`); old names: Catppuccin Latte
- `themes/frappe.theme.json`: Catppuccin Frappé (`catppuccin-frappe`); old names: Catppuccin Frappé
- `themes/macchiato.theme.json`: Catppuccin Macchiato (`catppuccin-macchiato`); old names: Catppuccin Macchiato
- `themes/mocha.theme.json`: Catppuccin Mocha (`catppuccin-mocha`); old names: Catppuccin Mocha
- `themes/latte-islands.theme.json`: excluded — Islands variant is outside the approved classic variant set.
- `themes/frappe-islands.theme.json`: excluded — Islands variant is outside the approved classic variant set.
- `themes/macchiato-islands.theme.json`: excluded — Islands variant is outside the approved classic variant set.
- `themes/mocha-islands.theme.json`: excluded — Islands variant is outside the approved classic variant set.

The old Alacritty spelling Catppuccin Frappe aliases the canonical Catppuccin Frappé; it is not shipped twice.
